steps.title: Open TRA IDARS Portal
steps.instruction: Open your web browser and go to uas.tra.go.tz
steps.instruction_sw: Fungua kivinjari chako cha mtandao na nenda kwenye uas.tra.go.tz
steps.expected_screen: Web browser with address bar visible
steps.success_indicator: TRA IDARS login page loaded with TIN and password fields visible

steps.title: Login to TRA IDARS
steps.instruction: Enter your TIN number in the first field and your password in the second field, then click 'Login'
steps.instruction_sw: Weka nambari yako ya TIN katika sehemu ya kwanza na nenosiri lako katika sehemu ya pili, kisha bonyeza 'Login'
steps.expected_screen: TRA login page with TIN and password fields
steps.success_indicator: TRA dashboard visible with taxpayer name shown

steps.title: Navigate to Returns Menu
steps.instruction: On the TRA dashboard, find and click the 'Returns' menu item in the top navigation bar
steps.instruction_sw: Kwenye dashibodi ya TRA, tafuta na ubonyeze kipengele cha menyu 'Returns' kwenye upau wa urambazaji wa juu
steps.expected_screen: TRA dashboard with navigation menu visible at top
steps.success_indicator: Returns submenu expanded showing VAT Return option

steps.title: Select VAT Return
steps.instruction: From the Returns dropdown menu, click on 'VAT Return'
steps.instruction_sw: Kutoka kwenye menyu ya chaguo la Marejesho, bonyeza 'VAT Return'
steps.success_indicator: VAT Return form or period selection page loaded

steps.title: Select Filing Period
steps.instruction: Select the tax period you are filing for (month and year), then click 'Proceed'
steps.instruction_sw: Chagua kipindi cha kodi unachojaza (mwezi na mwaka), kisha bonyeza 'Endelea'
steps.expected_screen: VAT Return period selection page with month/year dropdowns
steps.success_indicator: VAT Return entry form loaded with sales and purchases sections

steps.title: Enter Sales Figures
steps.instruction: In the Sales section, enter your total taxable sales for the period in the 'Taxable Sales' field
steps.instruction_sw: Katika sehemu ya Mauzo, weka jumla ya mauzo yako ya kikodi kwa kipindi hicho katika sehemu ya 'Mauzo ya Kikodi'
steps.expected_screen: VAT Return form with Sales section visible
steps.success_indicator: Sales figures entered and VAT calculated automatically

steps.title: Enter Purchases Figures
steps.instruction: In the Purchases section, enter your total taxable purchases and input VAT for the period
steps.instruction_sw: Katika sehemu ya Manunuzi, weka jumla ya manunuzi yako ya kikodi na VAT ya pembejeo kwa kipindi hicho
steps.expected_screen: VAT Return form with Purchases section visible
steps.success_indicator: Purchases figures entered and net VAT payable/refundable calculated

steps.title: Review and Submit
steps.instruction: Review all figures carefully. If everything is correct, click 'Submit Return' to file your VAT return
steps.instruction_sw: Kagua takwimu zote kwa makini. Ikiwa kila kitu ni sahihi, bonyeza 'Tuma Marejesho' kutuma fomu yako ya VAT
steps.expected_screen: VAT Return summary page with all figures and Submit button
steps.success_indicator: Confirmation message shown with acknowledgement number
